answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 96 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is recorded against the crystal challenge, the lantern audit can replay the delta history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 4998 identities would post 2371 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
